title: Iowa Environmental Mesonet airport observations
role: Historical EDDF METAR; true wind direction and knots. Archive has limited quality control.

title: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API
role: Fixed lead-time archives from past forecasts, not reanalysis.

title: NOAA Aviation Weather Center Data API
Umwelthaus current operating direction and forecast
role: Current operating direction sourced to DFS; no historical bulk labels obtained.

title: FraAlliance AI Week 2026 hackathon case, user supplied PDF
role: Challenge proxy thresholds. These are configurable challenge assumptions, not authoritative aviation limits.

title: OurAirports runway coordinates
role: Public-domain EDDF runway endpoints and dimensions; geographically projected with true north up. Runway widths are enlarged for readability.

title: OpenStreetMap terminal geometry
role: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Terminal 1/3 footprints and Terminal 2 label points; source feature IDs and URLs preserved in downloadable GeoJSON.

title: Frankfurt Airport official map
role: Official terminal context: Terminal 3 in use; Terminal 2 currently closed, verified 30 October 2026. This is current map context, not historical terminal status.

title: DFLD Frankfurt direction and wind history
role: 183 days, 30 April–29 October 2026: 8,784 half-hour Fraport-based reported direction bins and coarse wind bearings. Direction targets train and test v2. Europe/Berlin empirically checked against 240 METAR bins; 25 October DST excluded. Publication times unknown; labels never used as forecast-time inputs.

title: DFLD Frankfurt runway movement records
role: Three-day factual snapshot aggregated into hourly arrivals, departures and RWY18 use. Parsed counts reconcile with published daily and runway totals. No aircraft identifiers republished. Zero departures is not a closure label.

title: DFLD measurement methodology and reuse notice
role: Historical data can be corrected. No open-data license is stated. Only a concise attributed factual subset and derived aggregates are included; raw pages and DFLD graphics are not redistributed. See the linked reuse notice in Observed operations.
